Title: Azure Container Registry virtual network and firewall rules support is now in preview

Body.Content:
With virtual network and firewall rules support now available in Azure Container Registry in preview, you can now limit registry access within an Azure Virtual Network. In addition, you can also whitelist IP addresses and ranges for on-premises services, including Express Route connected devices.
